outline.text: Outpatient clinics earn most of their income from a few insurer contracts.
Demand for outpatient care is growing and the main competitors are regional groups.
Revenue is growing and margins are steady.
Cash flow covers interest but leaves little for repaying debt.
One maintenance covenant applies to the term loan.
The founders still hold a majority of the votes.
Staffing is the main environmental, social and governance risk.
